Let  
\[
a_k=\frac{k}{3^k}.
\]
Then the term becomes
\[
\frac{m^2 n}{3^m(n3^m+m3^n)}
=\frac{a_m^2 a_n}{a_m+a_n}.
\]
So the sum is
\[
S=\sum_{m,n\ge 1}\frac{a_m^2 a_n}{a_m+a_n}.
\]
By symmetry,
\[
2S=\sum_{m,n\ge 1}\frac{a_m^2a_n+a_na_m^2?}{a_m+a_n}
=\sum_{m,n\ge 1}a_ma_n
=\left(\sum_{k\ge1}\frac{k}{3^k}\right)^2.
\]
Now
\[
\sum_{k\ge1}\frac{k}{3^k}=\frac{1/3}{(1-1/3)^2}=\frac34,
\]
so
\[
2S=\left(\frac34\right)^2=\frac{9}{16}
\quad\Rightarrow\quad
S=\frac{9}{32}=0.28125.
\]
